summary: PHP CLI, common PHP extensions, Composer checks, local app runs, installation, updates, and diagnostics.

commons.summary: PHP and Composer common helpers for CLI availability, versions, PHP ini, and extension checks.

check.summary: PHP and Composer readiness command implementation.

install.summary: PHP and Composer installation command implementation.

run.summary: PHP local app run command implementation.

update.summary: PHP and Composer update command implementation.

check.summary: Checks PHP CLI, Composer, common PHP extensions, inline runtime execution, and optional configuration details.

options.--yes: Do not pause for the final acknowledgement prompt.
options.--verbose: Print PHP ini and global Composer configuration when available.
options.--json: Append a compact machine-readable result object.

expected_failure_when: One or more common PHP extensions are missing.

install.summary: Installs PHP CLI, common PHP extensions, Composer, and supporting tools with explicit prompts.

options.--dry-run: Print the detected install command path without executing it, even if PHP and Composer are already installed.
options.--json: Append a compact machine-readable result object.

supported_hosts.macos: Installs php and composer through Homebrew.
supported_hosts.debian_like_linux: Installs PHP CLI, common extensions, Composer, unzip, and git through apt.

run.summary: Starts a local PHP development server for a target directory and optionally opens it in a browser.

options.--host: Host interface for php -S. Defaults to 127.0.0.1.
options.--router: Optional PHP router script path, relative to target-dir or absolute.
options.--open: Open http://<host>:<port> after the server starts.
options.--dry-run: Print server and browser commands without executing them.
options.--json: Append a compact machine-readable result object.

expected_failure_when: PHP CLI is missing outside dry-run.
A blackhost PHP server PID file already points to a running process for the requested port.

update.summary: Updates PHP CLI, common PHP extensions, Composer, and supporting tools with explicit prompts.

options.--dry-run: Print the detected update command path without executing it, even if PHP and Composer are not installed.
options.--json: Append a compact machine-readable result object.

supported_hosts.macos: Updates php and composer through Homebrew.
supported_hosts.debian_like_linux: Updates PHP CLI, common extensions, Composer, unzip, and git through apt.

notes: check is host-read-only and does not install or update PHP or Composer.
run starts a local background PHP development server process and prints its stop command.
install and update mutate the host and prompt unless --yes is provided.
install and update support --dry-run where detected host command paths are printed but not executed.
dry-run must not short-circuit just because PHP and Composer are already installed or currently missing.
Composer is managed as part of the php package because it is PHP-specific development tooling.
